We hear big numbers every day. They’re harder to imagine. This is a small space to slow down and see the people behind them.

Every figure has its own place in an exact grid. Enter a whole number, scroll or pinch to zoom, and drag to explore. Hover over a figure to see its number.

Big crowds, honestly.

A screen has a limited number of pixels. When people become smaller than a pixel, you’ll see the crowd’s density. Zoom in to resolve individual figures again. No people are dropped or sampled.

Counts from 0 to 9,007,199,254,740,991 are supported. You can also type shortcuts like 100k, 1.5 million, or 8 billion.
